label: D20-backend-language

input.decision: Which language/runtime should the Anastrophe R1 backend (REST /v1 API, enrollment, credential issuance, reader sync) be implemented in?
input.priorities: Correct, auditable cryptography for certificate issuance and key handling; simple, reliable multi-region deployment (ADR-0014); a small team should be able to maintain it; reuse the shared anp1-v1 test vectors in CI.
requirements: Can sign ES256 COSE_Sign1 certificates with a key held in a cloud KMS/HSM without exporting the private key.
Can verify the shared anp1-v1 test vector values (P-256, HKDF-SHA256, AES-128-GCM) using maintained libraries.
Can be deployed identically to a primary and a hot-standby region with automated failover.

status: 0,60–0,80 → Provisional (ADR-0018); tinjau ulang di akhir M1.
